sections.bio:
Most people on LinkedIn are chasing impressions, algorithm hacks, and viral engagement.

I care about one metric: qualified pipeline.

If your content isn't booking sales calls, driving inbound deals, or building your company's enterprise value, it's just an expensive hobby.

I partner with founders and B2B leaders to build complete LinkedIn acquisition engines:

→ Organic Authority Content (attracting high-ticket buyers)
→ Outbound Prospecting & DM Systems (booking qualified calls)
→ Retargeting Ads (converting warm profile visitors)
→ Daily Account & Inbox Management (handling the daily execution)

Every piece feeds the next. Nothing runs in isolation.

Track record:
• Scaled 2 agencies from zero to $120k/mo and $200k/mo
• Built organic acquisition systems across 10+ B2B brands
• 100% focused on bottom-line client acquisition


Ready to turn LinkedIn into your #1 revenue channel?

→ DM me "SYSTEM"
→ Or reach out at: 💌 [email protected]

posts.text:
Confession: I spent years throwing away 30% of our best enterprise leads on purpose. 🤦‍♀️

And I genuinely thought I was being smart.

When you run cold outbound for clients, you live in constant fear of burning domain reputation. 

Every standard verification tool gave me the exact same warning on catch-all addresses:
"Risky. Do not send."

So I deleted them.

Dream enterprise accounts.
VP-level decision-makers.
The exact high-intent prospects my clients paid me to reach.

All deleted before sending a single email.

Because the alternative was risking an 8% bounce rate and landing our domains in spam prison. 💀

I tested a bunch of verifiers because I was tired of choosing between two bad options:

Option 1: Send to unverified catch-alls and watch client domain health get destroyed.

Option 2: Delete up to 35% of our addressable pipeline to stay safe.

Neither made sense.

That changed when I brought Allegrow into our stack.✨

Instead of guessing or forcing you to delete valid emails, Allegrow  runs live deliverability testing and safely verifies catch-all data so you know what will actually land in primary inboxes.

We instantly recovered almost a third of our lost enterprise leads, and bounce rates stayed under 2%. 💅

If your current outbound strategy involves deleting good leads out of domain fear, you do not have a deliverability problem. You have a tooling problem.

P.S. If you manage cold outreach right now, what is your rule for catch-all contacts? Do you risk sending to them or cut them from the list?

Turned another year older today. 🎂

For years, August 29 came with a quiet, heavy panic.

I would wake up obsessing over imaginary timelines, calculating everything I hadn’t built yet, and treating another year like a deadline I was running out of time to meet.

Every birthday felt like an exam I forgot to study for. 💀

Today is the first year that feels completely different.

🤍I trust my pace.
🤍I like who I'm becoming.
🤍And I finally stopped needing external permission to feel proud of myself.

Younger Muqaddas would probably be shocked that we made it through all the chaotic, messy phases to build something real.

The milestones will happen when they happen.

Just wanna say thank you to everyone who’s been supporting me, I genuinely appreciate you. 🫶

P.S. Drop your birthday below so I can return the love when your turn comes around. 🎈

I was inactive on LinkedIn for a full month.

Came back to 37 unread DMs.

Sounds exciting, right? Except most of them looked like this:

→ A cold pitch
→ A follow-up to the cold pitch
→ Another follow-up
→ A "just bumping this up" message
→ A "I guess you're not interested" guilt trip

All while my profile clearly showed I hadn't posted in weeks.

Here's the thing.

I wasn't ignoring anyone on purpose. I just needed a break. I wanted to spend time with my family, disconnect for a bit, and not think about work.

But some of these threads had 4-5 follow-ups sent days apart to someone who was clearly not active.

If you're doing cold outreach on LinkedIn, two things will instantly make you better than 90% of people in my inbox:

→ Check if the person is actually active before you pitch them. It takes 10 seconds to look at their recent activity.

→ After you send that first message, wait. If they're not online, they're not online. Sending 3-5 follow-ups in a week to someone who hasn't posted in a month isn't persistence. It's spam.

Good outreach is about timing and relevance, not volume.

Anyway. I'm back now.

If you DM-ed or emailed me while I was away, I'll get to you. Promise.

P.S. What's the wildest cold pitch you've ever received in your DMs? I need to know I'm not alone here.

3 years from now, you're going to wake up to this:

• 6 DMs from founders who found your content
• 2 referral calls already booked
• A waitlist. An actual waitlist.
• Revenue coming in while you were asleep

Your calendar is full.
Your rates doubled.
And you didn't run a single ad.

Want to know what made the difference?

You showed up. Every day. Even when nobody was watching.

That's it. That's the whole secret.

Here's the math nobody showed me when I started:

1 post = nothing.
1 post x 365 days = 365 reasons to trust you.
1 post x 365 days x 3 years = 1,095 touchpoints.

That's a client machine.
Built for free.
While you sleep.

I went from 0 to 3,400 followers without spending a dollar.

But I posted to silence for weeks.
No likes. No comments. No DMs.
Just me, talking into the void.

And then it compounded.

The founders who win on LinkedIn?

They're not the most talented.
They just didn't stop.

Your ideal client is on LinkedIn right now.

They're not hiring you.
They don't even know you exist.

Because you're not showing up.

So here's your challenge:

1. Post today.
2. Post tomorrow.
3. Don't stop for 3 years.

The math does the rest. 👇

P.S. How long have you been posting on LinkedIn? And do you feel like it's compounding yet?

You dont need to learn English to go viral in English.

Read that again. 💅

If you're a creator posting in your native language.

Hindi. Spanish. French. Arabic. Portuguese. Whatever.

You've probably thought about reaching international audiences.

But then:

"I dont speak English well enough."
"Translators are expensive."
"I'd have to re-record everything."

So you stayed local. Told yourself it's fine. 

But what if none of that matters anymore?

Synthesia just dropped a video translator and I genuinely wasn't expecting it to be this good.

You upload a video. Pick a language. Get it back in YOUR voice with perfect lip sync.

I thought it would look fake like every other AI tool.🙄

So I tested it. 

I grabbed a French video from Thomas Marcelle  founder of Naano 

Few minutes later he was speaking perfect English with the same voice, same face, lips moving naturally.

The result was honestly kind of crazy.

It didn't feel translated. It felt like he recorded it in English.

If language has been your excuse for staying local, that excuse just died. 

The world is waiting for your content my dear 

Drop "GLOBAL" below if you wanna try it free 👇
